node.statement: Validated node 1.2.2 gives rho_2>0, and validated node 1.2.3 gives rho_DeltaUpsilon>0, rho_mult>0, and rho_UpsilonDelta>0. These are exactly the four entries of (1.7), so their finite minimum rho_fac is strictly positive. By child 1.2.4.1, K>=1; hence 24*K>=24>0 and the real reciprocal (24*K)^(-1)>0. Since also 1>0, every entry of the minimum in (1.8) is strictly positive, so eta_K=min{rho_fac,(24*K)^(-1),1}>0. Together with child 1.2.4.1 this proves every conclusion of node 1.2.4.
